text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No way... We still can't go running yet? It's just been workouts day after day... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? What's with all the
long faces?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The nonstop raining over the past few
days has finally come to a stop. But the
deluge was so
heavy that the drainage
systems can't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the academy assigned all
available staff to help restore the track
back to its former state, whether it's
ready for use or not remains
debatable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Over here, everyone! Gather around! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek comes into view leading a
group of
children on a tour of the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the little ones have come out to
play! We
gotta look lively, folks!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hey, why isn't anybody running outside?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I'm so sorry, my dears. You see, we
can't run
out there with all the mud.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Aww man! But I wanna see!
Please run!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's that? You wanna see us in
action? Just
leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Feast your eyes, boys and girls,
on the
swiftest runner 'round these parts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One starts to run on the dirt track
swamped
with mud, but it isn't long
before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Skid!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yowch! I got too excited and totally

face-planted!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Inari, sweetheart, are you okay?!
Don't push
yourself so hard!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's take it easy today... yeah?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What?!
And after I just ate dirt like that?
Sorry,
but no can do!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know today's just a normal day of
training,
meaning it's necessary to pace
myself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But look at the hope in the little ones'
eyes!
You're really gonna ask me to spoil
my
reputation?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Inari, dear...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Besides, we're all dying to go
running.
Right, girls?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We're gonna let loose and
sprint at full
speed!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, and there they go... It looks
like there's
no stopping them now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, can I ask you to look after the
Umamusume? I'm worried I can't watch over
everyone by myself... It'd be
great if you could give them some
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I agree. If they run too fast, someone
might get
hurt.
choice_data_list: I'd like you to keep the speed down...
Just run like you always do and yo...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, you two can't be serious!
And I
already got everyone so fired up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Okaay, I can get behind that! I want y'all
to cheer
until your voices go hoarse!
choice_data_list: Let's at least get our spirits hyp...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, everyone, let's make some noise!
Hoot
and holler those lousy rain clouds
away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The children joyfully whoop and cheer
as the
boisterous Umamusume run about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, are you sure? What if they trip
and fall?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're saying we can race despite the
weather?
You sure you don't want us to
play it just a little
safe?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you say... All right, I'm gonna
show you
the run of a lifetime!
choice_data_list: No, sticking to the usual is fine.
No, sticking to the usual is fine.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're going stupid fast! Now this
is what
I'm talkin' about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As it's easier to achieve high speeds on
the soft, dirt track, their breakneck
racing is met with
great enthusiasm from
the children!
